name: deep-sea-diver
description: Deep Sea Diver — a mobile deep sea diving & fishing game, packaged for Android with Capacitor.

scripts.android:add: npm run build:web && cap add android
scripts.sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.serve: node scripts/copy-web.js && cd www && python3 -m http.server 8000
